dedupe_keys.name: jerusalem public shelter locations non governmental compilation

description: This repository holds the locations of public shelters in Jerusalem extracted from sources licensed under the Open Database Licence, with dated folders for each update and web maps in Google Maps and ArcGIS, including a nearby shelter finder. The README warns that it is a non-governmental source and that the data should not be relied on for personal preparedness or decisions; the author gives no warranty of accuracy or completeness. It is maintained by Daniel Rosehill; the last update is dated 12 August 2024. Coverage: Jerusalem. Access: free on GitLab and as web maps. Licence: ODbL as reproduced from the original sources. Caveats: unofficial, may be incomplete or out of date; check against the municipality's own shelter list. Simulation uses are walking access to shelters and shelter capacity scenarios in emergency response studies. Related records: other shelter datasets such as the Baltimore evacuation shelters and the Miami-Dade evacuation centres.
name: Jerusalem public shelter locations (non-governmental compilation)
